# SYSCALL / SYSENTER / SYSRET / SYSEXIT and the MSR model (ledger U900-U929): expected values from the
# independent model Emulator/tools/isa/ref_sysmsr.py (regenerate with --write, do not edit). Unicorn
# only, MAX model, 64-bit mode; without cpl=3 the snippet starts at CPL0:
#   emu-alltest --cases Emulator\data\cases_sysmsr.txt --expect-only
# --- SYSCALL (U901): the SDM transition. IA32_LSTAR = label k (the handler); after it: R15 = PUSHFQ
# image, R12/R13 = CS/SS selectors, RCX - k = 0, R11 = the RFLAGS image at SYSCALL (POPFQ input)
mov ecx, 0xC0000081; mov eax, 0x0; mov edx, 0x230010; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0xC0000084; mov eax, 0x47700; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0xC0000082; lea rax, [rip + k]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; wrmsr; mov rax, 0xED7; push rax; popfq; syscall; k: pushfq; pop r15; mov r12d, cs; mov r13d, ss; lea r14, [rip + k]; sub rcx, r14 =>! rcx=0 r11=0xED7 r15=0x8D7 r12=0x10 r13=0x18

mov ecx, 0xC0000081; mov eax, 0x0; mov edx, 0x230013; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0xC0000084; mov eax, 0x40701; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0xC0000082; lea rax, [rip + k]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; wrmsr; mov rax, 0x240ED7; push rax; popfq; syscall; k: pushfq; pop r15; mov r12d, cs; mov r13d, ss; lea r14, [rip + k]; sub rcx, r14 =>! rcx=0 r11=0x240ED7 r15=0x2008D6 r12=0x10 r13=0x1B
mov ecx, 0xC0000081; mov eax, 0x0; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0xC0000084; mov eax, 0x0; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0xC0000082; lea rax, [rip + k]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; wrmsr; mov rax, 0x202; push rax; popfq; syscall; k: pushfq; pop r15; mov r12d, cs; mov r13d, ss; lea r14, [rip + k]; sub rcx, r14 =>! rcx=0 r11=0x202 r15=0x202 r12=0x0 r13=0x8
mov ecx, 0xC0000081; mov eax, 0x0; mov edx, 0xFFFFFFFB; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0xC0000084; mov eax, 0x200; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0xC0000082; lea rax, [rip + k]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; wrmsr; mov rax, 0x246; push rax; popfq; syscall; k: pushfq; pop r15; mov r12d, cs; mov r13d, ss; lea r14, [rip + k]; sub rcx, r14 =>! rcx=0 r11=0x246 r15=0x46 r12=0xFFF8 r13=0x3

# IA32_EFER.SCE = 0: #UD, nothing changes (RCX keeps the MSR number, R11 its input)
mov ecx, 0xC0000080; rdmsr; and eax, 0xFFFFFFFE; wrmsr; syscall | r11=0x5555 =>! #UD rcx=0xC0000080 r11=0x5555
# CPL3 -> CPL0: SYSRETQ (IA32_STAR[63:48] = 23h: CS 33h, SS 2Bh) to label u at CPL3, SYSCALL there
# (IA32_STAR[47:32] = 10h); RBX = CS at CPL3, R12/R13 = CS/SS at the handler, R11 = RFLAGS at CPL3
mov ecx, 0xC0000081; mov eax, 0x0; mov edx, 0x230010; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0xC0000082; lea rax, [rip + k]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; wrmsr; lea rcx, [rip + u]; mov r11d, 0x8D7; .byte 0x48, 0x0f, 0x07; u: mov ebx, cs; syscall; k: pushfq; pop r15; mov r12d, cs; mov r13d, ss; lea r14, [rip + k]; sub rcx, r14 =>! rbx=0x33 rcx=0 r11=0x8D7 r15=0x8D7 r12=0x10 r13=0x18
# --- SYSCALL CET (U901), CR4.CET = 1 (CR0.WP = 1). Supervisor shadow stack: IA32_PL0_SSP = T = MEM + 9FF8h,
# token at T, SETSSBSY (SSP := T); IA32_PL3_SSP = P = 7FFF12345670h before SYSCALL; after it RBP = RDSSPQ
# (input 5555h: a NOP when shadow stacks are off at CPL 0), R8 = IA32_PL3_SSP, R9 = IA32_S_CET
mov rax, cr0; bts rax, 16; mov cr0, rax; mov rax, cr4; bts rax, 23; mov cr4, rax; mov ecx, 0x6A2; mov eax, 0x1; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0x6A4; mov eax, 0x30029FF8; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0x6A7; mov eax, 0x12345670; mov edx, 0x7FFF; wrmsr; .byte 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xe8; mov ecx, 0xC0000082; lea rax, [rip + k]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; wrmsr; syscall; k: .byte 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x1e, 0xfa; .byte 0xf3, 0x48, 0x0f, 0x1e, 0xcd; mov ecx, 0x6A7; rdmsr; shl rdx, 32; or rax, rdx; mov r8, rax; mov ecx, 0x6A2; rdmsr; shl rdx, 32; or rax, rdx; mov r9, rax | rbp=0x5555 m+0x9FF8=F89F023000000000 =>! rbp=0x0 r8=0x30029FF8 r9=0x1 m+0x9FF8=F99F023000000000
mov rax, cr0; bts rax, 16; mov cr0, rax; mov rax, cr4; bts rax, 23; mov cr4, rax; mov ecx, 0x6A2; mov eax, 0x5; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0x6A4; mov eax, 0x30029FF8; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0x6A7; mov eax, 0x12345670; mov edx, 0x7FFF; wrmsr; .byte 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xe8; mov ecx, 0xC0000082; lea rax, [rip + k]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; wrmsr; syscall; k: .byte 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x1e, 0xfa; .byte 0xf3, 0x48, 0x0f, 0x1e, 0xcd; mov ecx, 0x6A7; rdmsr; shl rdx, 32; or rax, rdx; mov r8, rax; mov ecx, 0x6A2; rdmsr; shl rdx, 32; or rax, rdx; mov r9, rax | rbp=0x5555 m+0x9FF8=F89F023000000000 =>! rbp=0x0 r8=0x30029FF8 r9=0x5 m+0x9FF8=F99F023000000000

mov rax, cr0; bts rax, 16; mov cr0, rax; mov rax, cr4; bts rax, 23; mov cr4, rax; mov ecx, 0x6A2; mov eax, 0x0; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0x6A4; mov eax, 0x30029FF8; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0x6A7; mov eax, 0x12345670; mov edx, 0x7FFF; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0xC0000082; lea rax, [rip + k]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; wrmsr; syscall; k: .byte 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x1e, 0xfa; .byte 0xf3, 0x48, 0x0f, 0x1e, 0xcd; mov ecx, 0x6A7; rdmsr; shl rdx, 32; or rax, rdx; mov r8, rax; mov ecx, 0x6A2; rdmsr; shl rdx, 32; or rax, rdx; mov r9, rax | rbp=0x5555 m+0x9FF8=F89F023000000000 =>! rbp=0x5555 r8=0x7FFF12345670 r9=0x0 m+0x9FF8=F89F023000000000
mov rax, cr0; bts rax, 16; mov cr0, rax; mov rax, cr4; bts rax, 23; mov cr4, rax; mov ecx, 0x6A2; mov eax, 0x4; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0x6A4; mov eax, 0x30029FF8; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0x6A7; mov eax, 0x12345670; mov edx, 0x7FFF; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0xC0000082; lea rax, [rip + k]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; wrmsr; syscall; k: .byte 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x1e, 0xfa; .byte 0xf3, 0x48, 0x0f, 0x1e, 0xcd; mov ecx, 0x6A7; rdmsr; shl rdx, 32; or rax, rdx; mov r8, rax; mov ecx, 0x6A2; rdmsr; shl rdx, 32; or rax, rdx; mov r9, rax | rbp=0x5555 m+0x9FF8=F89F023000000000 =>! rbp=0x5555 r8=0x7FFF12345670 r9=0x4 m+0x9FF8=F89F023000000000
mov rax, cr0; bts rax, 16; mov cr0, rax; mov rax, cr4; bts rax, 23; mov cr4, rax; mov ecx, 0x6A2; mov eax, 0x4; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0xC0000082; lea rax, [rip + k]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; wrmsr; syscall; k: nop =>! #CP(3)
# CPL3 -> CPL0 with IA32_U_CET = SH_STK_EN | ENDBR_EN only: SYSRETQ loads SSP := IA32_PL3_SSP = P; SYSCALL
# saves IA32_PL3_SSP := LA_adjust(SSP) = P; no shadow stack and no tracker at CPL 0 (no ENDBR64 needed)
mov rax, cr0; bts rax, 16; mov cr0, rax; mov rax, cr4; bts rax, 23; mov cr4, rax; mov ecx, 0x6A0; mov eax, 0x5; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0x6A7; mov eax, 0x12345670; mov edx, 0x7FFF; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0xC0000081; mov eax, 0x0; mov edx, 0x230010; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0xC0000082; lea rax, [rip + k]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; wrmsr; lea rcx, [rip + u]; mov r11d, 0x202; .byte 0x48, 0x0f, 0x07; u: .byte 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x1e, 0xfa; syscall; k: nop; mov ecx, 0x6A7; rdmsr; shl rdx, 32; or rax, rdx; mov r8, rax; mov ecx, 0x6A0; rdmsr; shl rdx, 32; or rax, rdx; mov r9, rax =>! r8=0x7FFF12345670 r9=0x5
# --- SYSENTER (U902): the SDM transition (64-bit mode). IA32_SYSENTER_EIP = label k, IA32_SYSENTER_ESP =
# RSP - 100h (RBP = the old RSP); after it R15 = PUSHFQ image, R12/R13 = CS/SS, R14 = RBP - RSP = 100h
mov ecx, 0x174; mov eax, 0x10; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0x176; lea rax, [rip + k]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; wrmsr; mov rbp, rsp; lea rax, [rsp - 0x100]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; mov ecx, 0x175; wrmsr; mov rax, 0xED7; push rax; popfq; sysenter; k: pushfq; pop r15; mov r12d, cs; mov r13d, ss; mov r14, rbp; sub r14, rsp =>! r15=0xCD7 r12=0x10 r13=0x18 r14=0x100
mov ecx, 0x174; mov eax, 0x13; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0x176; lea rax, [rip + k]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; wrmsr; mov rbp, rsp; lea rax, [rsp - 0x100]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; mov ecx, 0x175; wrmsr; mov rax, 0x243AD7; push rax; popfq; sysenter; k: pushfq; pop r15; mov r12d, cs; mov r13d, ss; mov r14, rbp; sub r14, rsp =>! r15=0x2438D7 r12=0x10 r13=0x18 r14=0x100
mov ecx, 0x174; mov eax, 0x8; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0x176; lea rax, [rip + k]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; wrmsr; mov rbp, rsp; lea rax, [rsp - 0x100]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; mov ecx, 0x175; wrmsr; mov rax, 0x202; push rax; popfq; sysenter; k: pushfq; pop r15; mov r12d, cs; mov r13d, ss; mov r14, rbp; sub r14, rsp =>! r15=0x2 r12=0x8 r13=0x10 r14=0x100
mov ecx, 0x174; mov eax, 0xFFFF; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0x176; lea rax, [rip + k]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; wrmsr; mov rbp, rsp; lea rax, [rsp - 0x100]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; mov ecx, 0x175; wrmsr; mov rax, 0x40246; push rax; popfq; sysenter; k: pushfq; pop r15; mov r12d, cs; mov r13d, ss; mov r14, rbp; sub r14, rsp =>! r15=0x40046 r12=0xFFFC r13=0x4 r14=0x100
mov ecx, 0x174; mov eax, 0x23; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0x176; lea rax, [rip + k]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; wrmsr; mov rbp, rsp; lea rax, [rsp - 0x100]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; mov ecx, 0x175; wrmsr; mov rax, 0x200ED6; push rax; popfq; sysenter; k: pushfq; pop r15; mov r12d, cs; mov r13d, ss; mov r14, rbp; sub r14, rsp =>! r15=0x200CD6 r12=0x20 r13=0x28 r14=0x100
# IA32_SYSENTER_ESP/EIP bits 63:32 are used in IA-32e mode: RSP = FFFF8000_12345678h (no stack use after it)
mov ecx, 0x175; mov eax, 0x12345678; mov edx, 0xFFFF8000; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0x176; lea rax, [rip + k]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; wrmsr; mov rbp, rsp; sysenter; k: mov rbx, rsp; mov rsp, rbp =>! rbx=0xFFFF800012345678
# CPL3 (compatibility mode, entered with SYSEXIT, IA32_SYSENTER_CS = 10h: CS 23h, SS 2Bh) -> 64-bit mode CPL0:
# RBX = CS in compatibility mode, R12/R13 = CS/SS after SYSENTER, R14 = RSP - (RBP - 100h) = 0
mov ecx, 0x174; mov eax, 0x10; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0x176; lea rax, [rip + k]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; wrmsr; mov rbp, rsp; lea rax, [rsp - 0x100]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; mov ecx, 0x175; wrmsr; lea rdx, [rip + u]; mov rcx, rsp; .byte 0x0f, 0x35; u: mov ebx, cs; sysenter; k: mov r12d, cs; mov r13d, ss; lea r14, [rbp - 0x100]; sub r14, rsp; neg r14 =>! rbx=0x23 r12=0x10 r13=0x18 r14=0
# the same from 64-bit mode CPL3 (SYSEXIT REX.W: CS 33h)
mov ecx, 0x174; mov eax, 0x10; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0x176; lea rax, [rip + k]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; wrmsr; mov rbp, rsp; lea rax, [rsp - 0x100]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; mov ecx, 0x175; wrmsr; lea rdx, [rip + u]; mov rcx, rsp; .byte 0x48, 0x0f, 0x35; u: mov ebx, cs; sysenter; k: mov r12d, cs; mov r13d, ss; lea r14, [rbp - 0x100]; sub r14, rsp; neg r14 =>! rbx=0x33 r12=0x10 r13=0x18 r14=0
# IA32_SYSENTER_CS[15:2] = 0: #GP(0), nothing changes
mov ecx, 0x174; mov eax, 0x0; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; sysenter =>! #GP(0) rcx=0x174 rax=0x0 rdx=0x0
mov ecx, 0x174; mov eax, 0x3; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; sysenter =>! #GP(0) rcx=0x174 rax=0x3 rdx=0x0
mov ecx, 0x174; mov eax, 0x10000; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; sysenter =>! #GP(0) rcx=0x174 rax=0x10000 rdx=0x0
# --- SYSENTER CET (U902), as for SYSCALL above: T = MEM + 9FF8h (SETSSBSY), P = IA32_PL3_SSP
mov rax, cr0; bts rax, 16; mov cr0, rax; mov rax, cr4; bts rax, 23; mov cr4, rax; mov ecx, 0x6A2; mov eax, 0x5; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0x6A4; mov eax, 0x30029FF8; mov edx, 0x0; wrmsr; mov ecx, 0x6A7; mov eax, 0x12345670; mov edx, 0x7FFF; wrmsr; .byte 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xe8; mov ecx, 0x176; lea rax, [rip + k]; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; wrmsr; mov rbp, rsp; mov rax, rsp; mov rdx, rax; shr rdx, 32; mov ecx, 0x175; wrmsr; mov ebp, 0x5555; sysenter; k: .byte 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x1e, 0xfa; .byte 0xf3, 0x48, 0x0f, 0x1e, 0xcd; mov ecx, 0x6A7; rdmsr; shl rdx, 32; or rax, rdx; mov r8, rax; mov ecx, 0x6A2; rdmsr; shl rdx, 32; or rax, rdx; mov r9, rax | m+0x9FF8=F89F023000000000 =>! rbp=0x0 r8=0x30029FF8 r9=0x5 m+0x9FF8=F99F023000000000
